revision_basis.reason: Compatibility provenance retained for the original fail-closed phase-1 implementation.

roundtrip_revision_basis.diagnosis: Revision 0.4 proved exact binary regeneration of the frozen geometry-generation DEM but La Libertad still failed because the frozen D8 catchment was polygonized to WGS84 and then re-rasterized by cell-center inclusion. Its accepted outlet lies 3.29 m outside the reprojected frozen polygon boundary, and the re-rasterized polygon has no direct in-mask D8 predecessor into the excluded outlet cell. This is a raster-vector-raster boundary representation issue, not permission to alter the frozen polygon or outlet.
roundtrip_revision_basis.correction_scope: Routing topology only for an excluded pour point with no direct in-polygon predecessor. Reconstruct the canonical D8 upstream set from the exact frozen geometry-generation DEM and frozen outlet; require at least 99.5 percent of frozen-polygon center cells to route to that outlet; require every canonical D8 cell outside the frozen polygon to be either the frozen outlet or within one Moore-neighbor cell of the frozen polygon; keep polygon mask, polygon metrics, elevation/slope cell inclusion and drainage-density link semantics unchanged.

frozen_geometry_input.source: exact GitHub Actions geometry artifacts referenced by the outlet-freeze registry
frozen_geometry_input.verification: SHA256 of each downloaded GeoJSON must exactly equal geometry_geojson_sha256 in the frozen registry

exact_geometry_dem_reconstruction.hard_integrity_gate: regenerated DEM GeoTIFF SHA256 must exactly equal geometry_freeze.dem_utm_sha256 for every target before morphometry is accepted
exact_geometry_dem_reconstruction.fallback: none; any hash mismatch fails closed

canonical_d8_roundtrip_bridge.activation: only when the frozen outlet cell is outside the frozen-polygon cell-center mask and no frozen-polygon D8 cell routes directly into that outlet
canonical_d8_roundtrip_bridge.canonical_topology: reverse D8 traversal from the unchanged frozen outlet on the exact binary-matched geometry-generation DEM
canonical_d8_roundtrip_bridge.outside_cell_gate: every canonical D8 upstream cell not selected by the frozen-polygon cell-center mask must be either the frozen outlet cell or Moore-adjacent to at least one frozen-polygon cell
canonical_d8_roundtrip_bridge.bridge_entry_gate: at least one frozen-polygon cell must route directly into an allowed canonical outside boundary cell that reaches the frozen outlet
canonical_d8_roundtrip_bridge.main_channel_rule: maximum D8 distance to the frozen outlet among frozen-polygon center cells that route to it; allowed canonical boundary bridge links are included only in the routing distance
canonical_d8_roundtrip_bridge.drainage_density_rule: unchanged: sum only qualifying D8 links whose upstream and downstream cells are both inside the exact frozen-polygon cell-center mask

cell_inclusion.polygon_metrics: project exact frozen polygon to EPSG:32718
cell_inclusion.raster_metrics: cell center inside polygon; rasterio all_touched=false
cell_inclusion.nodata: exclude non-finite or DEM nodata cells

hydrology.routing_integrity: at least 99.5 percent of exact frozen-polygon center cells must route to the frozen outlet
hydrology.drainage_density_threshold: contributing area >= 0.01 * exact frozen polygon planar area

forbidden: read A6680 numeric morphometry before phase-1 output hash is frozen
use metric values observed in failed phase-1 runs to tune a method
move an outlet or alter/expand a frozen basin polygon
alter a geometry contract, chosen margin, source tile, DEM conditioning, slope algorithm, D8 method, channel threshold or cell-inclusion rule to improve a result
accept a regenerated DEM whose GeoTIFF SHA256 differs from the frozen geometry-generation DEM hash
treat arbitrary non-polygon routing cells as part of the basin; only the fail-closed canonical boundary bridge rule is admissible
change polygon area, elevation/slope mask or drainage-density link inclusion because of the bridge
discard a target because of unexpected morphometry
